caption: The drawing depicts a metal container, likely an oil can, with cylindrical body segments and a conical upper section leading to a narrower neck. The container is primarily gray with patches of brownish rust, indicating wear. There is a round, flat, brass-colored cap with a circular loop handle on the top of the neck, and a short spout protrudes diagonally from the neck just below the cap. The can has a wire handle, bent at sharp angles, attached to loops on each side of the container, with a dark wooden grip at the top. The surface of the container is reflective with areas showing highlights and shadows, and the background is plain and off-white.
title: Oil Can
